comments.author: aorth
comments.story: A Company That Tears Cars Apart to Find Out How They're Built
comments.why: Munro explains why the BMW i3 was a watershed car.
comments.text: I don't follow the car industry but I did happen to catch this 2015 video of Munro talking about the BMW i3. He says things like "this is the watershed," "they invented new science," "this is the Model T of our time," etc. I got a whole new respect for BMW after watching that video. Munro even followed the production chain to Morocco while investigating the costing! [VIDEO]

comments.author: _s
comments.story: BMW Loses Core Development Team of Its I3 and I8 Electric Vehicle Line
comments.why: Manufacturing tech inside the i3, framed as the Model T of our time.
comments.text: There was a video ( [VIDEO] ) posted recently discussing the manufacturing tech within the i3; absolutely fascinating - the general gist being how this car is the Model T of our time. Perhaps it is a big loss or not that great; eitherway I believe the company will do just fine - they've set themselves up very well for the future unlike many of the other manufacturers in terms of brand, mobility, innovating / delivering on new tech / processes etc.
